selection: All5 architectures and2 seeds. Per discovery task axis choose maximum subspace-energy group in each seed; also seed2 geometric match of seed1 choice. Two random groups per fit sampled seed861 excluding all selected groups. Selection fixed before intervention outcomes.
interventions: Projection: recipient rawstate + orthogonal projection of raw donor difference onto group span. Encoded: recipient rawstate + donor-minus-recipient decoded group vector times each native rawRMS. Shared group vector includes own gate and union-coded member coordinates; overlapping groups are not additive causal attributions. No norm calibration or gain tuning.
evaluation: All78 aligned H849 pairs both directions, agreement/sentiment formats and gaps. Full raw donor and identity controls. Task selection is discovery-supervised and tasks broadly reused; not unsupervised semantic recovery. Random groups rank matched but not norm matched; record edit norms.
question: Does a geometrically/behaviorally stable component carry task-selective causal effects, or is signal distributed/encoder-limited?
